description: This PHP script handles displaying event information within the TestLink open source test management tool. It initializes page parameters, loads event and user data from the database, and renders a template for viewing event details, while also checking user permissions.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns the page arguments, notably the event ID.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies whether the current user has the rights to view the events page.
